Class TaAccountService

java.lang.Object
com.bupt.ta.service.TaAccountService
public final class TaAccountService extends Object
Self-service onboarding for TA accounts with server-side validation.

Forgotten passwords are delegated to admins because SMTP token flows were out of scope. Error codes surfaced to servlets correspond to constants below for uniform handling.

      public void registerTa(String email, String plainPassword, String confirmPassword, String fullName, String phone, String department, String studentId)

    • registerUser

      public void registerUser(String email, String plainPassword, String confirmPassword, String fullName, String phone, String department, String studentId, UserRole role)
      Persists an active TA credential record after enforcing uniqueness and password policy.

      Note: the persisted role is always UserRole.TA for this codebase path; the explicit role parameter exists solely for callers sharing the validator.

      Parameters:
      email - registration mailbox (trimmed on save)
      plainPassword - first password capture
      confirmPassword - repeated password capture
      fullName - display/legal name required on portal profile
      phone - optional handset (blank becomes null)
      department - optional school text (blank becomes null)
      studentId - optional enrolment identifier (blank becomes null)
      role - ignored at persistence time; onboarding always emits UserRole.TA
      Throws:
      ConstraintViolationException - with one of the ERR_* constants on validation failure
